packageRules.description: typescript-eslint peers typescript <6.1.0. Without this cap Renovate opens a TypeScript 7 PR every week that verify.sh correctly rejects.
Node baseline is a deliberate LTS policy decision. Renovate would push .nvmrc to the current non-LTS release.
Digest pinning is right for a generated project but wrong inside template files, where it would emit scaffolds full of SHAs that read as stale on day one.
